name: Magnet Pull
note: Spring-damped magnetic attraction: the button chases the cursor inside a 130px field, label and halo ring parallax at different rates, press adds a squash impulse.
html: move the cursor closer

name: Gooey Merge
note: Five metaballs orbit a pill through an SVG blur/contrast goo filter. Idle they bulge the edges, hover pulls them out into droplets, click flings them with a spring return. Filter and gradient ids are minted at runtime so two copies never collide.

name: Liquid Fill
note: Two seamless SVG wave crests scroll at different speeds over a rising liquid line, with bubbles climbing inside. Hover lifts the level, click toggles it full with an overshoot slosh and a splash ripple at the pointer.

name: Spark Burst
note: Canvas particle field on a device-pixel-ratio surface: embers drift up from the button at rest, a click throws 80 sparks with gravity, drag and additive blending plus two expanding shockwave rings.

name: Trace Border
note: A normalised pathLength=1 outline: a comet dash runs the perimeter forever, hover draws the full border in one stroke, click fires a fast retrace with a light sweep across the label. No JS path measurement needed.

name: Roll Letters
note: Each glyph lives in a clipped cell over a two-face stack. Hover rolls them up on a 26ms stagger with an overshoot spring, and an idle wave rolls the word by itself every 4.2 seconds. aria-label keeps the name intact.

name: Chromatic Glitch
note: Cyan and magenta screen-blended text layers driven by a decaying heat value: idle micro-tears, hover raises the storm, click spikes heat to 1.6 while random clip-path slice bands tear across and a scanline sweeps.

name: Spinner To Tick
note: Three states on one spring: the arc spools up from an idle crawl to a fast spin, then decelerates as the green ring draws, the tick strokes itself on and a shockwave pops. Words slide through a clipped slot and it resets itself after 2.3s.
